notes:
Summary: Early-stage platform company building a GitHub-style PR review assistant that suggests inline comments, produces compact diff summaries, and reranks candidate suggestions. High emphasis on privacy (no external code leaving VPC), low-latency interactive mode for IDE streaming, and deterministic model/version pinning for reproducible reviews.

Disco call 2026-02-16 (Maya, Diego, CTO - Arjun):
- CTO: 'We cannot send private repos to 3rd-party unmanaged endpoints.' Wants VPC or on-prem option.
- Primary ask: integrate with GitHub Actions + Checks API, run PR analysis on push and surface suggestions as review comments.
- Secondary: IDE plugin streaming for reviewers (VSCode) — must start streaming within 300-800ms for small diffs.

Security touchpoints:
- Completed basic questionnaire; sent full security FAQ (drive link). Waiting on SCIM/SAML diagrams. Legal flagged data residency + retention.
- Wants audit logs exposed per-reviewer and per-repo. KMS/HSM a plus.

Technical requirements / acceptance criteria for POC:
- Two-week POC across three repos (backend, infra, monorepo).
- Latency: median end-to-end suggestion latency <800ms for diffs <80 LOC when using dedicated pool; 95th <2.5s.
- Throughput: sustain 8 concurrent PR analysis jobs, with burst to 20 for business hours.
- Model controls: ability to pin model version per-repo and rollback; prefer quantized code models (fp16/8) for cost.
- Features: diff summarization, suggested review comments (context-aware), reranking of N=10 suggestions, deterministic seeding for reproducible outputs.
- Streaming: chunked token streaming to VSCode extension + fallback to full response.

Commercial / procurement notes:
- Interested in Dedicated for predictable latency and isolation. Open to Hosted if VPC peering solves residency.
- Cost sensitivity moderate — willing to commit for enterprise SLA once perf/accuracy validated. Estimated ARR target 50k-150k.

Recent activity timeline:
- 2026-02-16: Intro + discovery (Maya) — asked for architecture whiteboard.
- 2026-02-19: Technical deep-dive with infra (Diego) — discussed autoscaling and kernel selection.
- 2026-03-02: Security sync, provided initial answers; legal escalation on residency.
- 2026-03-08: Demo request submitted; scheduled POC kickoff 2026-03-17 pending SSO setup.

Quotes / misc notes:
- Eng lead: 'We need reproducible reviews — same prompt + model version should give same summary.'
- PM: 'If reranking reduces noise in suggested comments, reviewers save ~30% time.'

Next steps (short):
- Provide POC runbook + perf baseline template (owner: Diego).
- Setup SCIM/SAML demo and provide SSO docs (owner: Maya).
- Legal to confirm residency options and draft DPA addendum (owner: Redwood legal).

External refs: Jira for infra questions PRJ-6842, internal infra ticket INF-7101. Fireflies recordings attached for both technical and security sync.

CRM shorthand / quick bullets:
- Wants VPC/on-prem; high security + audit.
- Primary use-case: PR review assistant + IDE streaming.
- Key metrics: median latency <800ms, 95th <2.5s, throughput burst to 20 jobs.
- Blockers: legal residency + SSO integration.
- Close plan: POC -> perf signoff -> Dedicated commit (May).
